title: Bringing the Dharma Home
speaker: IkuShun Desiree Webster
summary: IkuShun Desiree Webster emphasizes the importance of cultivating awareness and acceptance in everyday life, particularly during challenging moments. They share their personal experience of letting go of rigid thinking and attachment, which allowed them to find freedom and clarity. By embracing imperfection and impermanence, one can develop wisdom and compassion, leading to a more courageous and objective approach to life's difficulties.
